description:
Open a Git push on a website, app, agent, or skill that exists, named by name: a branch of its repository, writable for one hour, that you push source to before you publish. Use it when you can run git with network access; it sends only what changed, so a large service publishes without carrying its files through the conversation. Otherwise publish with files. The service must exist first: create_service makes it.

First make a Git key that stays on your machine, and pass its SHA-256 as key_sha256. Never send the key or put it in a command. Run this; its output is the hash:
umask 077; export VALET_GIT_KEY_FILE="$HOME/.config/valet/git-key"; mkdir -p "${VALET_GIT_KEY_FILE%/*}"; [ -s "$VALET_GIT_KEY_FILE" ] || head -c 32 /dev/urandom | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n' > "$VALET_GIT_KEY_FILE"; (sha256sum 2>/dev/null || shasum -a 256) < "$VALET_GIT_KEY_FILE" | cut -d' ' -f1

The result carries a Git URL with no credential, the push's id and branch, the commit it starts from, the name and email to commit as, the limits, and two recipes that read your key from the file: clone the branch and edit, or push a directory as it stands. A push over the limits is refused. Run a recipe, then call publish_site, publish_app, publish_agent, or publish_skill with push: {id, commit}, where commit is the sha the recipe prints. Delete the key file when you finish: rm -f "$VALET_GIT_KEY_FILE". Only you can publish a push you opened. The key writes only this push's branch, cannot force-push, and expires with the push. A service holds ten open pushes at once. Requires connecting a Valet account.

idempotency_key.description: An opaque key of your choosing. Repeating a call with the same key returns the same push instead of opening a second one, and replaces the push's key_sha256, which makes a retry safe.

key_sha256.description: Required. The lowercase hex SHA-256 (64 characters) of the Git key you generated on your machine. Never send the key itself.

name.description: The website's, app's, agent's, or skill's name.

org_name.description: The Valet organization it belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: create_push
title: Open a Git push
